name: good_boy
caption: i can't get away from this man 😭
logline: Someone keeps trying to leave an old man and keeps ending up right back at his side; only the camera knows why.
question: why does he keep ending up next to this guy??
premise: The narrator has tried to leave a man 37 times. Every time he gets twelve blocks away he is standing next to him again. He's fed raw porkchops, sits when told, everyone is tall, he can't open doors, he waits by the door all day, skeletons run from him, and a dog is always exactly where he is.
twist: He's the man's dog: a tamed wolf. Tamed wolves teleport to their owner from 12 blocks, sit on command, can't open doors, scare skeletons and attack whatever hurts their owner. First-person shots hide it (a wolf's eye height); every camera shot shows the wolf at the man's side. The reveal is the first shot that starts in his head and pulls out, on 'Good boy.'

N.name: me
N.profile: a young man, earnest and hushed, telling a friend something he can't explain
N.on_screen: POV at a wolf's eye height; in camera shots, a tamed wolf with a red collar

Sam.name: the man
Sam.profile: an old man, gravelly, slow and gentle

requests.direction: Read this short film dialogue, the night scene: quieter, then frightened, then tender.

lines.text: I've tried / to LEAVE / this man / THIRTY-SEVEN / times.
lines.direction: steady, a held breath before the number

lines.text: Every time / I get TWELVE / blocks away... / I'm standing / RIGHT / next to him.
I've tried / at NIGHT. / Through the WHEAT. / I even / SWAM for it.
lines.direction: listing, building, a little out of breath

lines.text: He feeds me / RAW / porkchops. / Never COOKED. / Not ONCE.
lines.direction: a dry aside, matter of fact

lines.text: And when he / says SIT... / I SIT. / I don't / know WHY.
Everyone / in this village / is so TALL.
And there's / this DOG. / Wherever / I go... / it's ALREADY / there.
lines.direction: suspicious, slower, the last word low

lines.text: I can't / even open / a DOOR.
When he LEAVES, / I wait / by the door. / ALL day.
lines.direction: simple, a small ache in it

lines.text: SKELETONS / run when / they SEE me.
Then one night, / a ZOMBIE / came for HIM.

lines.direction: startled, in pain, an old man's shout

lines.text: I don't REMEMBER / what happened / NEXT.

lines.direction: out of breath, calming, very close
tender, a smile in it, slow
